verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a Node/TS library built on Playwright with a scriptable API (act/observe/extract), headless browser support via Browserbase or CDP-attached Chromium, and npm-installable package confirmed via runtime probe, making CI/headless automation straightforward. missing for 10: explicit first-party CI pipeline examples (GitHub Actions/Docker recipes) and independent hands-on confirmation of a full unattended CI run.
